evals.prompt: Show me what files I've changed but not committed in my current checkout.
evals.expected_output: Agent resolves the correct checkout (not just workspace root), runs git status --short and ls-files --others, reports staged/unstaged/untracked separately with a summary line. If clean, says so.

evals.prompt: I'm working in a linked worktree at ~/proj/worktrees/fix-123. What's uncommitted there?
evals.expected_output: Agent runs git -C ~/proj/worktrees/fix-123 status --short (not from workspace root), detects linked worktree, reports dirty files for that specific checkout with branch and path context.

evals.prompt: Are there any untracked files I might have forgotten to add?
evals.expected_output: Agent resolves context, runs git ls-files --others --exclude-standard on the correct checkout, lists untracked files. If over 20, gives a count summary instead of full list.
